title: Reject overflowing total IK chain length
description: FabrikSolver validated each individual link length as finite and positive, but the accumulated total chain length was allowed to overflow to Infinity. That could invert the reachability decision and permit subsequent arithmetic to operate outside the solver's finite contract. Reject the overflow at the accumulation boundary. Preserve normal behavior for all finite totals and do not introduce a global magnitude clamp without evidence that the domain requires one.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: Implemented in FabrikSolver.Solve by checking the running total immediately after each addition. Added FabrikSolverTests.Solve_RejectsFiniteLinkLengthsWhoseTotalOverflows. Unity/test-runner validation is unavailable in this harness.
